Attached: 1 image

Wake up and smell the AI Agents attempting to access Banking platforms. 

Wells Fargo updates its Online Access Agreement that formally shifts liability for every transaction an AI Agent makes onto the customer.    

Net-Net:  if an AI agent makes a mistake in your Wells Fargo account, you own it.   The Bank also requires customers to be ready to formally prove they revoked AI Agent access.  https://www.techtimes.com/articles/329947/20261103/wells-fargo-just-made-you-legally-responsible-every-transaction-your-ai-agent-makes.htm
